skills.name: applicant-kit
skills.description: Agent skill that writes the better version of your application material: decoded JD table, action-task-result-impact bullets, honest keyword placement, five resume summaries, a LinkedIn rewrite, 20 interview answers. Only experience you already have; nothing invented. Sibling recruiter-lens does the judging. For Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Qoder.

skills.name: application-pilot
skills.description: Runs the job search around the applications: live shortlist from your criteria, rubric-based fit scores with evidence, a reviewable tracker with follow-up dates, aging flags, drafted follow-ups, interview briefings and a weekly funnel read. Never submits, never invents. No CLI, no telemetry, no browser automation.

skills.name: do-better
skills.description: Agent skill: a tournament of sub-agents over one task. Every competitor gets the identical task and a different strategy card, then attacks, defends, and a judge scores each match on a written rubric until one champion survives. For when a retry won't fix the answer. Qoder CLI skill, Claude Code plugin. Adapted from Arena (MIT).

skills.name: findable
skills.description: Agent skill that sets up discovery for a GitHub repo, agent skill, Claude Code plugin or MCP server: audits where you rank today, derives the queries strangers type, drafts About text, topics, README opening, release notes and a site page, lists directories and plans a dated re-check. Never invents stars, rankings or sample output.

skills.name: keyword-guard
skills.description: Agent skill that plans SEO topic clusters and ends keyword cannibalization, so one page wins each query. It maps query ownership before any title, H1 or content change, from Search Console or a sitemap when you lack GSC access. Covers on-page, link-authority and hreflang checks. White-hat, no API keys. Runs in Claude Code, Cursor, Qoder.

skills.name: pre-ship-security-red-team
skills.description: Agent skill that red-teams a web app you own before launch: three subagents run 14 authorization and abuse checks (IDOR, role escalation, quota races, open redirects, XSS, SSRF, cache leaks, prompt injection) with captured evidence, then fix and rerun. Local isolated environments only. Claude Code, Cursor, Qoder.

skills.name: recruiter-lens
skills.description: Agent skill that reviews resumes, CVs and LinkedIn profiles the way recruiters screen them: 6-second scan, ATS check, rejection reasons, gaps against a job description, likely interview questions. It never invents a metric. Its sibling applicant-kit writes the fix. For Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Qoder.

skills.name: topic-primer
skills.description: Agent skill for Claude Code, Cursor and Qoder that teaches any topic you name, from absolute zero to expert depth, in 8 modes: foundation, curriculum, concept chains, adaptive tutor, mental models, pitfalls, examiner, ELI5. One question at a time, honest grading, every term defined, no fabricated facts or resources.

skills.name: upstream-check
skills.description: Agent skill that finds unpushed local commits and fast-forwards only the safe ones, plus checks published listings against the repos that actually ship a SKILL.md.

skills.name: web-preflight
skills.description: Agent skill for a pre-launch website check on a site you own: before you deploy, it looks for exposed .env, .git, config and debug files. Status codes are signals, not findings: it tells a real /.env leak from an SPA catch-all 200 or a blanket WAF 403, and marks unrun checks INCONCLUSIVE, never a false pass. No exploitation or port scanning.

skills.name: wordsmith
skills.description: Agent skill for Claude Code, Cursor and Qoder that drafts, rewrites, tightens and proofreads text. 44 commands over 5 disciplines: build, evaluate, refine, adapt, prepare. Meaning, facts, hedges and the author's voice carry through; shaky claims get flagged for checking instead of papered over.
